---
name: code-review
description: Reviews JavaScript files in the src/services and src/api directories for missing callback error paths, unhandled promise rejections, direct database access outside a repository, missing JSDoc comments on exported functions, and inconsistent import ordering. Use when the user asks to review a file in those directories that was changed in the current branch and has an existing test file.
---

# Code review

Review the file or diff the user named. Work through these checks in order.

1. Read the file and the tests that cover it.
2. Check error handling on every path that can fail. Flag any callback or promise without an error path.
3. Check the change against the conventions in the project configuration file.
4. Report findings as a list, most severe first. State the file and line for each one.

Report findings only. Do not edit files.
